source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary: **[Death Befitting an Officer](vsdata:ability/astra-militarum.leman-russ-commander.death-befitting-an-officer)** applies if the Leman Russ Commander is destroyed in the enemy Shooting phase. Roll one D6 while the tank is still on the table, before resolving [Deadly Demise](vsdata:core-ability/deadly-demise). A 2+ lets the tank stay and fire back once the unit that destroyed it has shot. That unit is the only eligible target for the return fire. Resolve Deadly Demise and remove the tank as soon as it finishes shooting, or at phase end if it has not shot.
